question: Do the MMSU and Quirino, Ilocos Sur project notices provide fish observations or site-resolved evidence suitable for the Luzon species baseline?

method.summary: Reviewed the full text of MMSU's official 29 November 2024 project announcement. The Municipality of Quirino, Ilocos Sur page was discoverable through its official-site indexed text, which exposed the complete announcement body; a direct page fetch timed out during this review. Cross-checked the existing Nagao Foundation 2026 Luzon field-report registry entry and its 30 October review only to distinguish that report's Cagayan/Ilocos Norte survey scope from this later municipal coordination notice; the original report was not reopened for this artifact.

directRetrieval.mmsu2024Notice: Full official page opened and reviewed.
directRetrieval.quirinoLgu2026Notice: Official-site indexed article text reviewed; direct page request timed out. No page image or downloadable attachment was inspected.
directRetrieval.nagao2026SurveyReport: Existing registered source and review cross-referenced; no new raw-file retrieval performed.

mmsu2024Announcement.title: Japanese scientist to collaborate with MMSU on aquatic research
mmsu2024Announcement.reportedPlan: MMSU describes a proposed collaboration with OIST and Hokkaido University on freshwater and estuarine fish and larval dispersal along the Kuroshio Current. It names East and West coasts of Northern Luzon, Palawan, Taiwan, and Japan as comparative study areas, and says the project was scheduled to begin in 2025.
mmsu2024Announcement.localPartner: MMSU College of Aquatic Sciences and Applied Technology in Ilocos Norte; the announcement also mentions BFAR and the Ilocos Norte Provincial Government as supporting partners.

quirinoIlocosSur2026Announcement.title: MMSU Researchers Visit Quirino for International Scientific Study on Northern Luzon Gobies
quirinoIlocosSur2026Announcement.reportedEvent: MMSU personnel paid a courtesy visit to the Office of the Municipal Mayor to coordinate local research activities.
quirinoIlocosSur2026Announcement.reportedLocalProjectTitle: Fishery and Stock Assessment of Gobies in Northern Luzon, Philippines
quirinoIlocosSur2026Announcement.reportedBroaderProgram: Fauna and Life History of Freshwater and Estuarine Fish of the Philippines: Toward Elucidation of the Larval Dispersal Mechanism of Diadromous Fish along the Kuroshio Current
quirinoIlocosSur2026Announcement.reportedCollaboratorsAndSupport: The indexed announcement names OIST and Japan's Nagao Environmental Foundation and says the municipality expressed support.

existingNagao2026LuzonReport.scopeFromExistingReview: The previously reviewed report describes field sampling in Cagayan and Ilocos Norte during 2026-01-26 to 2026-02-13. It does not establish sampling or fish results in the Municipality of Quirino, Ilocos Sur.
existingNagao2026LuzonReport.crosswalkDecision: Do not extend the existing Cagayan/Ilocos Norte report's localities or taxon observations to Quirino, Ilocos Sur based only on shared collaborators or a broader program title.

localityCrosswalk.placeAsNamedByLgu: Municipality of Quirino, Province of Ilocos Sur
localityCrosswalk.disambiguation: This municipal project notice concerns Quirino municipality in Ilocos Sur. It must not be assigned to Quirino Province in Region II.

interpretation: The MMSU page is project-planning context, not a fish survey result. The Quirino LGU notice documents local coordination and stated support, not completed sampling or published stock-assessment findings.
Neither notice names sampled rivers, streams, estuaries, stations, dates of field sampling, collection methods, fish taxa, counts, vouchers, sequence accessions, or a downloadable dataset.
A goby-focused project title is not evidence that any particular goby species occurs in Quirino or in a named local waterbody.
The broader project title and collaborators do not establish that the Quirino municipal work shares sampling events with the already reviewed Nagao Cagayan/Ilocos Norte report.

No species assertions, occurrence rows, abundance values, waterbody assignments, coordinates, geometry, photos, legal/safety/diet claims, or public app records are added. No source text or images are republished; item-specific reuse terms for the Quirino LGU article were not verified.

decision.reason: The official pages establish a research-program and municipal-coordination lead in Quirino, Ilocos Sur, but provide no species results, named sampling waters, event metadata, vouchers, or item-specific reuse clearance.

nextAction: Search for a publicly accessible MMSU, OIST, Nagao Foundation, or municipal publication containing actual Quirino, Ilocos Sur field dates, named waterbodies and stations, methods, taxon evidence or voucher/accession identifiers. Keep this project-context lead separate from Quirino Province in Region II and from the previously reviewed Cagayan/Ilocos Norte field report until a direct crosswalk is published.
